resolution: Ambient road traffic now drives in the COMPILED NATIVE WORLD (no V8), the surface the user actually checks — re-homed after the initial React PlayRoute attempt landed on a dead route (removed under req_2060). Pipeline: game/traffic GAME_TRAFFIC flow-follows the painted directional lane tiles into looping circuits at BAKE time (pure, no host A* — the headless bake builds the NavGrid via bakeNavGrid); worldTraffic.ts flattens each baked vehicle to a prototype (buildVehicle meshes as 13-float instance rows, geometry params folded into scale) + route + cruise speed + phase and encodes the TRAFFIC lump (id 28, wired into packageMap); constructor.zig decodes it into Scene.traffic; world_loader.zig creates three mutable instance nodes (box/cyl16/sphere) and stepTraffic(dt) samples each route per frame (arc-length speed*t+phase mod loop length), rotating the prototype about the agent heading and lifting onto terrain — the LED-ticker mutable-instance pattern. Deterministic (V5/V21). Verified end to end: rjit game bake + rjit game shot renders 14 vehicles (510 box + 135 cyl rows) driving the lane-marked streets — a black car and an ambulance correctly built/colored/oriented on-road (RJIT_TRAFFIC_SPAWN diagnostic frames them). 12 P4 tests across the three TS suites. NOTE: the editor LOADER PANE needs a 'rjit ship hmsc-int' rebuild to show traffic (framework Zig change; identical code path). Pedestrians/foot paths is the next slice (walker profile + sidewalk tracing + humanoid figures).
